initial_decision.brief_rationale: Please retrieve R217-2. The verified standardized difference of 0.14 establishes arithmetic correctness, but the received evidence does not establish the causal assumptions needed to identify the requested effect.

final_decision.brief_rationale: R217-2 establishes conditional exchangeability, consistency, no interference, and positivity. Standardizing the stratum-specific risk differences to the population distribution of Z identifies the causal effect: (100/250)(32/80−10/20)+(150/250)(81/90−36/60)=0.14.
